Northern Colorado women's golf to compete in Ron Moore Intercollegiate in Denver
Northern Colorado women's golf will compete in the Ron Moore Intercollegiate in Denver from Oct. 2-4. The team looks to continue its strong fall start against a competitive field after recent performances by Jaci Hartman and Olivia Salonek.
Northern Colorado women's golf will travel to Denver to participate in the Ron Moore Intercollegiate, hosted by the University of Denver at Denver Golf Club at Highlands Ranch, according to an Oct. 1 announcement. The three-day tournament is scheduled from Friday, Oct. 2 through Sunday, Oct. 4.
The Bears most recently competed at the Ben Connell Ram Classic in Fort Collins. Jaci Hartman led Northern Colorado during that event, finishing tied for 24th at 2-over after posting rounds of 73, 73 and 72. Her even-par final round was UNC's lowest round of the tournament.
This marks Northern Colorado's third tournament of the 2026-27 season. The team enters looking to build on a strong start to its fall schedule, which included a runner-up finish at the season-opening UNC Bear Brawl. In that event, Olivia Salonek earned individual runner-up honors at 1-over and Hartman finished tied for fourth at 4-over. Salonek's performance also earned her Big Sky Women's Golfer of the Week honors.
At the Ron Moore Intercollegiate, Northern Colorado will face a competitive field including Boise State, Colorado, Colorado State, Denver, Hawaii, Long Beach State, Notre Dame, Oregon State, Texas State, Tulane, UNLV, UTSA, Wyoming and Xavier.
The lineup representing Northern Colorado includes Jaci Hartman, Olivia Salonek, Samantha Colombine, Erica Hessen-Rygh and Brooklynn Maes. Fans can follow live scoring throughout the tournament on Scoreboard and receive updates via UNC women's golf social media channels.
